svg.title: Inside a spec-driven agentic flow — technical, dark theme
svg.desc: Dark technical diagram of a spec-driven agentic workflow. User intent and Spec.md cards converge into an Orchestrator (purple panel showing example task chips: auth, ui, api, test). Orchestrator flows down to Context assembly (purple panel showing source chips: system, spec, files, skills, results) — per-call curated bundle, not raw dump. Context flows into Agent execution (purple panel) with two cards (LLM call, Tool execution) connected by tool-use inner loop: tool_calls go right, results return left, loops until LLM returns no more tool calls. Down arrow to Verifier card (with teal accent stripe) — separate agent that checks output against spec criteria. A dashed purple fail-loop arc returns up the left side back to the Orchestrator labeled fail re-plan. Pass arrow leads down to Persistent memory substrate (purple strip) with five compartments: spec.md, context, skills, memory, results. Bottom teal panel "What this enables" with four columns: Stateful, Managed context, Tool use, Verifiable.
svg.text: What happens when you direct agents instead of prompting
Per call: curated bundle, not raw dump
Loops until LLM returns no more tool calls
